Overview

Southaven is a city in MS with a population of 55,000. Memphis suburb in northern Mississippi with the Snowden Grove Amphitheater. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
